section_header: EMISSION CONTROL SYSTEMS — Positive Crankcase Ventilation (PCV) System
title: POSITIVE CRANKCASE VENTILATION (PCV) SYSTEM

content.description: Schematic diagram showing the PCV system with air cleaner, throttle valve, orifice, and engine cylinders. Arrows indicate flow paths for blow-by gas (solid arrows) and fresh air (dashed arrows).

content.text: To reduce HC emission, crankcase blow-by gas (HC) is routed through two metering orifices to the intake manifold for combustion in the cylinders
INSPECTION OF PCV HOSES AND CONNECTIONS

items.title: VISUALLY INSPECT HOSES, CONNECTIONS AND GASKETS
items.description: Check for cracks, leaks or damage.

diagram.description: Illustration showing PCV hoses and connections on engine

items.title: CLEAN TWO ORIFICES
items.description: Clean off any gum deposits in the orifices with solvent and blow out with compressed air.

diagram.description: Illustration showing two orifices on engine component
